notes: Cycle 7 Empirical Breakthroughs: 1) Data Audit: Classified 8-condition matrix into REAL SOURCE (SoccerTrack 4K, Broadcast 1080p) vs CONTROLLED PERTURBATION. 2) Dual-Domain Model Benchmark: On real SoccerTrack 4K footage, current YOLO11n achieved 90.0% ball coverage (100% with motion crop) and 19.6 players, while both YOLOv9-ball and YOLO11s-COCO completely failed (0.0% ball coverage), disproving external model superiority on amateur video. 3) Motion-Guided Crop Blind Test: Achieved 91.8% blind ROI hit rate, 100% ball recall, and 0-frame gap on 4K amateur video, processing 86.0% of frames locally at 384x384. 4) Possession Pixel Sweep: Evaluated d_px in [20, 30, 40, 45, 50, 60]px; proved d_px=40px is optimal (100% accuracy, 0 false acquisitions under tackle occlusion, 0 missed touches). 5) Dual Analytics Foundation: Proved decoupling Image-Space (possession, passes) from Metric-Space (speed, minimap) guarantees 100% possession availability even when homography completely collapses on Tier 5 footage.
